description.en: Modular React component library built on Tailwind CSS for dashboards and charts.
description.zh: 基于 Tailwind CSS 打造的现代化 React 数据仪表盘与可视化组件库。

content.en: Tremor is the go-to React component library for building modern dashboards and data-dense web applications. Built on Tailwind CSS and Recharts, Tremor provides beautifully styled metric cards, area charts, bar charts, sparklines, and tracker bars that require zero chart configuration headaches.
content.zh: Tremor 是前端构建现代数据看板（Dashboard）与分析平台的事实标准库。它基于 Tailwind CSS 与 Recharts 构建，将复杂的数据图表抽象为极简易用的指标卡片、面积图、柱状图、微型趋势线与状态追踪条，让开发者无需繁琐配置即可交付企业级可视化。
